are_you_ok.title: Number of CPS Energy customers without power drops to the hundreds days after storms tear through San Antonio
are_you_ok.summary: Severe thunderstorms tore through Bexar County on Friday, with wind gusts reaching 75 miles per hour and causing widespread damage that knocked out power for more than 100,000 CPS Energy customers. The city opened six resilience hubs and the San Antonio Food Bank scheduled three food distribution events for residents still without power, while CPS Energy said restoration would run through Tuesday night. The outage count fell from six figures to fewer than 2,000 and then to the hundreds, though some families spent the wait in homes sitting in the low 90s. No repeat of the storms is forecast for the following seven days.
